Security and privacy

Available

Your logs stay on this device. DiGe-FN does not upload anything, and a content security policy stops the page from sending data to other sites.

The PIN is a screen lock: it keeps people out of the app but does not encrypt the logs stored on the device. If you forget it, the only reset is clearing this site's data, which erases logs that are not backed up. Encrypted backups cover the JSON backup file only, not Excel files, shift packets or save codes.

Our Vision

Standardized, fast field data capture that is organized from the moment it is logged.

DiGe-FN is built around one goal: every geologist captures drill-core data the same way, quickly, on a mobile device at the rig, and the data arrives already organized for the geologist, the team and the office.

Field logging is done under time pressure. Each interval, survey, remark and photo should be recorded once, in a fixed structure, with the hole, run, depth and geologist attached automatically. The phone app is the capture tool. The desktop app takes the same records and finishes the work: checking, summarizing, charting and exporting.

DiGe-DS (Digital Geology Desktop Studio) is the desktop side of the system. DiGe-FN captures in the field; DiGe-DS takes the same records and brings them together for checking, summarizing, charting and exporting, so the field data and the office data stay one dataset.

DiGe-FN also works as a training tool. Rock, mineral and alteration references sit beside the log, so a new geologist can check an observation and learn the reasoning behind it, not just the answer.

The ultimate goal is for every geologist to log consistently, and to become a better geologist even without the tool.
